```yaml
name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  evaluate:
    name: Run Skill Evaluation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run evaluation and capture token usage
        # The EvaluateCommand is expected to write token-usage.json in the repo root
        run: dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator/EvaluateCommand.csproj -- --output token-usage.json

      - name: Upload token usage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: token-usage.json

  trigger-aggregation:
    name: Trigger Token Data Aggregation
    needs: evaluate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger downstream aggregation workflow
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: 'aggregate-token-data.yml'
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: main
          wait-for-completion: true
          wait-timeout-seconds: 300

  notify:
    name: Notify Slack
    needs: evaluate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Post Slack message
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.1
        with:
          method: chat.postMessage
          payload: |
            {
              "channel": "#devops",
              "text": "Token usage metrics collected for run ${{ github.run_id }}."
            }
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
```
